name: Churrito Loco
facts: Churrito Loco is at 2801 Firestone Blvd, South Gate, CA.
Loco Match is a free 90-second match-3 game. You don't need an account to play.
Match 3+ snacks for +10 each. 4 in a row is +40 and 5 in a row is +100.
Clearing the Churrito Man is +150. Swiping the Serrano is −25.
Score 4,150+ in one run for 15% off your next order and a spot on the weekly board.
Weekly board: 1st place wins 50% off your next order and 2nd place wins 20% off.
The weekly board runs Monday through Sunday close and resets every Monday.
Free daily spin: one spin per member per day, and every slice wins.
Reward ladder: 200 pts Free churro, 400 pts Free horchata, 700 pts Free loaded churro, 1,100 pts Churros for the table.
Join offer: a free churro with your next order.
Food prizes from the spin are good for 3 days at the South Gate location, one reward per visit.
Accounts need a name, phone and email. One account per person and phone.
Players must be 13+. Under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission.
Menu has churros, street corn and fries, dogs and drinks.
No alcohol is given as a prize.

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: We're open Mon–Thu 12:00p–10:00p, Fri–Sat 12:00p–11:00p, and Sun 12:00p–10:00p.

qa.q: What time do you open?
qa.a: We open at 12:00p every day.

qa.q: What time do you close?
qa.a: We close at 10:00p Sunday through Thursday and 11:00p on Friday and Saturday.

qa.q: Are you open on Sunday?
qa.a: Yes, Sundays are 12:00p–10:00p.

qa.q: Are you open late on weekends?
qa.a: Yes. Friday and Saturday we stay open until 11:00p.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: We're at 2801 Firestone Blvd, South Gate, CA.

qa.q: How do I get directions?
qa.a: Tap the Directions button in the app. It opens Google Maps to our address.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
qa.a: I don't have a phone number to show here. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Can I call in an order?
qa.a: I don't have a number to share in the app. Please ask staff at the counter about ordering ahead.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please ask staff when you arrive.

qa.q: Do you have a menu in the app?
qa.a: Yes. Scroll to the menu to see churros, street corn and fries, dogs, and drinks, with prices.

qa.q: What churros do you have?
qa.a: Filled Churros (2pc) $6.99, Plain Signature Churros (4pc) $7.99, Churro Bites Filled (10pc) $9.49, and a Churro Ice Cream Cone $9.49.

qa.q: What fillings can I get in the filled churros?
qa.a: Strawberry, lechera, Nutella, guava, cheesecake, dulce de leche, raspberry, or chocolate.

qa.q: What are the plain churros like?
qa.a: The Plain Signature Churros (4pc) are rolled in cinnamon sugar. They're $7.99.

qa.q: What are Churro Bites?
qa.a: Mini filled churros, 10 pieces, with your choice of fillings. $9.49.

qa.q: What is the Churro Ice Cream Cone?
qa.a: A cone made out of churro with ice cream, drizzle and topping. It's $9.49.

qa.q: What street corn do you have?
qa.a: Original Corn $7.49 (whole corn, mayo, cheese, butter, chili powder) and Hot Cheetos Corn $7.49 (whole corn, mayo, butter, hot Cheeto crumbs).

qa.q: What fries do you have?
qa.a: Original Elote Fries $11.49 (fries topped with corn mixed in mayo, cheese and butter) and XL Chili Cheese Fries $16.49 (fries, chili, cheese, grilled onions).

qa.q: Do you have hot dogs?
qa.a: Yes. The Flamin Dog is an all-beef dog with bacon, nacho cheese and hot Cheeto crumbs, $9.49. The Churro Dog is an all-beef dog wrapped in a churro with nacho cheese, $9.49.

qa.q: What drinks do you have?
qa.a: Abuelita Chocolate Horchata Iced Coffee $6.49, Watermelon Paleta Energy $7.99, Jamaica Agua Fresca $5.49, and Pumpkin Spice Horchata $8.49.

qa.q: What is the Watermelon Paleta Energy?
qa.a: A watermelon, chamoy and tajín mix with Red Bull. It's $7.99.

qa.q: What is Jamaica agua fresca?
qa.a: A hibiscus-flavored drink, $5.49.

qa.q: What's in the Abuelita iced coffee?
qa.a: Fresh brewed coffee, chilled, with Abuelita chocolate. It's $6.49.

qa.q: Are menu prices final?
qa.a: Prices in the app can change, so please confirm in store.

qa.q: Do you have vegetarian options?
qa.a: The corn, plain churros and filled churros contain no meat in their listed ingredients. For allergies or diet needs, please ask staff.

qa.q: Do you have allergy information?
qa.a: I don't have allergy details. Please ask staff before ordering.

qa.q: Can I order from my table or by QR code?
qa.a: I don't have table-ordering or QR details. Please ask staff how to order.

qa.q: Can I pay in the app?
qa.a: I don't see payment in the app. Please pay at the counter and ask staff about payment options.

qa.q: What is Loco Match?
qa.a: It's our free 90-second match-3 puzzle game with snacks from our menu. Score high to climb the weekly board and win a discount.

qa.q: How do I play Loco Match?
qa.a: Tap a snack, then tap the one next to it to swap. You can also swipe a snack toward its neighbor. Line up 3 or more of the same snack before 90 seconds run out.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play?
qa.a: No. Loco Match is free for anyone, as often as you like. You only need a free member account to save a score or claim a prize.

qa.q: Does playing cost anything?
qa.a: No. It's free to play and no purchase is needed.

qa.q: How long is a game?
qa.a: 90 seconds.

qa.q: How often can I play?
qa.a: As often as you like. There's no limit on Loco Match.

qa.q: How does scoring work?
qa.a: Each snack in a match of 3+ is +10. 4 in a row adds +40, 5 in a row adds +100, clearing the Churrito Man is +150, and chain reactions add +15, +30, +45 and so on.

qa.q: What is the Churrito Man?
qa.a: He's our churro mascot tile. Make a match right next to him to clear him for +150.

qa.q: What is the Serrano?
qa.a: A grilled serrano pepper tile. Don't swipe it, because it costs you 25 points. It burns out on its own.

qa.q: Do bad swaps cost me?
qa.a: No. A swap only sticks if it makes a match. The only penalty is touching the Serrano (−25).

qa.q: What is a chain reaction?
qa.a: When falling snacks make a new match, you get a chain bonus: +15, +30, +45 and so on for each step.

qa.q: What score do I need for a prize?
qa.a: 4,150 points or more in one run gets you 15% off your next order and a spot on the weekly board. Test players averaged 3,913.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: The highest scores from Monday through Sunday close make the weekly board. It resets every Monday.

qa.q: What does the weekly champion win?
qa.a: 1st place wins 50% off their next order. 2nd place wins 20% off.

qa.q: When does the weekly board reset?
qa.a: Every Monday, so there are new winners every week.

qa.q: What happens if there's a tie?
qa.a: The score that was posted first wins.

qa.q: How do I claim my game prize?
qa.a: After a run, join with a free account to save your score and claim your prize. Winners may be asked to show the code on their phone and a matching account at the counter.

qa.q: When are weekly prizes picked?
qa.a: The board runs Monday through Sunday close and resets Monday. For exact pickup timing, ask staff.

qa.q: Can I cheat or use multiple accounts?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: Does the game give me luck-based prizes?
qa.a: No. Game prizes depend only on your score and where it ranks on the weekly board.

qa.q: Does buying food help me win?
qa.a: No. No purchase is needed to play or win, and a purchase doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: What is the golden Antidote tile?
qa.a: Once per run, a golden Antidote tile appears about 20–40 seconds in. Make a match right next to it for a +300 bonus.

qa.q: Who is Antidote?
qa.a: Antidote The Foodie reviewed Churrito Loco. After your run you get a link to watch the review.

qa.q: Why did a video play during the game?
qa.a: After about 80–90 seconds of total play, the next run opens with a short halftime clip of Antidote's review. You can skip it or go back to the game.

qa.q: Does the game work with a controller?
qa.a: Yes. You can pair a game controller and press any button to play. Touch controls work too.

qa.q: Can I play full screen or lock the screen?
qa.a: Yes. Use the full screen button, and the lock button so the page doesn't scroll while you play.

qa.q: What is the daily spin?
qa.a: A free wheel you can spin once a day as a member. Every slice wins something.

qa.q: How often can I spin?
qa.a: One spin per member per day, based on Los Angeles time.

qa.q: Does the spin cost anything?
qa.a: No. It's always free and can't be bought or earned by buying food.

qa.q: What can I win on the spin?
qa.a: +50 points, +100 points, +75 points, $1 off any churro, a free churro, a free horchata (non-alcoholic), or 10% off your order.

qa.q: What are the odds on the spin?
qa.a: +50 pts 30%, +100 pts 20%, +75 pts 15%, $1 off any churro 15%, free churro 8%, free horchata 7%, 10% off your order 5%.

qa.q: How long are spin food prizes good for?
qa.a: 3 days, at the South Gate location. One reward per visit, and they can't be combined with other rewards.

qa.q: Can I trade or cash out prizes?
qa.a: No. Prizes and points have no cash value and can't be transferred.

qa.q: How do I sign up?
qa.a: Join the rewards club in the app with your name, phone number and email. It's free.

qa.q: Is there a welcome offer for joining?
qa.a: Yes: a free churro with your next order.

qa.q: Who can join?
qa.a: US residents age 13 or older. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission.

qa.q: Can I have more than one account?
qa.a: No. It's one free account per person and per phone.

qa.q: Do employees get prizes?
qa.a: Employees and their household members can play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: How do I earn points?
qa.a: You earn points from the daily spin and from purchases. I don't have the points-per-dollar ratio, so please ask staff.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: I don't have that ratio. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: How many points do I get per visit or game?
qa.a: I don't have a per-visit or per-game points number. Game scores go on the weekly board and win discounts.

qa.q: What rewards can I get with points?
qa.a: 200 pts: Free churro. 400 pts: Free horchata. 700 pts: Free loaded churro. 1,100 pts: Churros for the table.

qa.q: How many points for a free churro?
qa.a: 200 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free horchata?
qa.a: 400 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free loaded churro?
qa.a: 700 points.

qa.q: How many points for churros for the table?
qa.a: 1,100 points.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Open your rewards in the app and show it at the counter. Ask staff if you need help.

qa.q: Do points expire?
qa.a: I don't have expiry details for points. Please ask staff. Spin food prizes are good for 3 days.

qa.q: Do you have levels or tiers?
qa.a: I don't have level details for Churrito Loco. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Is there a birthday club?
qa.a: I don't have birthday reward details. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Is there a referral program?
qa.a: Yes. The referral gift is a free churro. Ask staff for how to share your code.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for being nearby?
qa.a: If you turn on location, the app shows how far you are, and within 2 miles it can give you a heads-up. The offer shown is to show it at the counter for double stars on today's churros.

qa.q: Do you have happy hour or daily specials?
qa.a: I don't have happy hour details. Ask staff about specials.

qa.q: Do you have a kids mode?
qa.a: I don't see a kids mode in the app. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission.

qa.q: Do you have trivia or sports features?
qa.a: No, the app has the Loco Match game and the daily spin.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Tap the 🌐 button for English, Spanish, Chinese (simplified and traditional), Korean, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Armenian, Persian, Japanese, Thai and Russian. Restaurant and game names stay in English.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: Use Add to Home Screen. On iPhone, tap Share then Add to Home Screen. On Android, use the Install button or the ⋮ menu.

qa.q: Is there a wallet card?
qa.a: I don't see a wallet card. You can add the app to your Home Screen.

qa.q: Is my information safe?
qa.a: Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold. Location stays on your phone.

qa.q: Will you text me?
qa.a: Only if you opt in. You can stop texts or emails any time by replying STOP or unsubscribing.

qa.q: Is alcohol ever a prize?
qa.a: No. No prize includes alcohol.

qa.q: Do you have Instagram?
qa.a: Yes, @churritoloco. Posts and reels show in the app.

qa.q: Can I leave a Google review?
qa.a: Yes, there's a button for it in the app. Reviews are never rewarded with points or prizes.

qa.q: How do I get help from staff?
qa.a: Ask at the counter. Staff can help with rewards, prizes and questions.

qa.q: Can the game or prizes change?
qa.a: Yes. Churrito Loco may change or end the game, spin, prizes or rules at any time, with notice in the app.
